observations.body: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain…
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Moses leads the flock to Horeb and encounters the burning bush.
observations.label: Beyond the grazing land

observations.body: The wilderness route brings Moses to Horeb and the fire that does not consume the bush.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Exodus 3:1–3 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Moses sees the wonder before he knows who is calling or what will be asked.
payload.title: Moses beyond the wilderness
